slides.title:
The AI Dev
Stack of 2025
slides.subtitle: A live readout of the tools shipping faster code, fewer bugs, and smarter pull requests.

items.title: Cursor
items.text: Agentic IDE built on VS Code with full repo context and inline diffs.

items.title: GitHub Copilot
items.text: Mature suggestions, chat, and PR summaries across every major language.

items.title: Codeium
items.text: Free tier with strong autocomplete and a self-hosted option for teams.

items.title: CodeRabbit
items.text: Line-by-line review comments tuned to your repo conventions.

items.title: Greptile
items.text: Indexes the whole codebase to flag architectural drift in PRs.

items.title: Ellipsis
items.text: Auto-generated changelogs and review summaries on every push.

items.title: Sweep
items.text: Turns GitHub issues into ready-to-merge pull requests autonomously.

items.title: CodiumAI
items.text: Generates meaningful unit tests with edge cases your suite missed.

items.title: Qodo Cover
items.text: Iteratively raises coverage by writing and validating real tests.

items.title: Momentic
items.text: Natural-language end-to-end tests that survive UI refactors.
